plugins.name: session-recall

plugins.name: session-recap

plugins.name: topic-roadmap
plugins.description: Inventory cross-source work on a topic — PRs + openspec/SDD changes + docs/RFCs + branches + memories — into a 6-layer lifecycle roadmap (Idea → Discovery → Spec → Implementation → Review → Done) with Mermaid diagram + JSON inventory.

plugins.name: distill-lint
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a Claude Code knowledge base. Detects orphans, stale notes, dead refs, broken cross-references, index-budget violations. Inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki Pattern + Luhmann Zettelkasten. Complements `distill-learnings` (write side).

plugins.name: lectura-bionica
plugins.description: Bionic-reading transformer for Markdown — bold the first half of each word ≥3 letters to create a visual anchor that reduces eye regressions. WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility (SC 1.4.8 + SC 1.4.12) for ADHD/dyslexia readers. Zero deps Python, 24 pytest cases.
